description:
The latest news the site's hubs print, newest first, with date, headline, source and page.

Use it for "what is new" and "latest announcement" questions. It holds the eight newest items
of each hub: obesity, Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly. `company` matches the hub (Novo Nordisk,
Eli Lilly) or the drug's sponsor, `drug` a drug or brand in the item or its headline, `query`
a word in the headline (MASH, approval). `kind` on a Novo hub item says what it is (clinical,
regulatory, corporate, results, competitor: a rival's event that bears on Novo). An event older
than a hub's eight newest is not here: say so rather than guess. A headline's efficacy figure is
on the estimand the headline names, if any, and is not comparable with one on another.
name: list_news
title: List latest news
